# Mani Ratan Pratap Singh (MRPS) — Full System & Knowledge Repository

## Identity & Philosophy
- Full Legal Name: Mani Ratan Pratap Singh
- Known As: Mani Ratan Singh (MRPS)
- Motto: "My Simplicity Is My Identity."
- Geographic Base: Purvanchal, Uttar Pradesh, India
- Primary Digital Home: https://maniratansingh.com
- Technical Workbench & Homelab: https://mrps.in
- Direct Email: email@mrps.in

Mani Ratan Pratap Singh is a technology generalist, systems builder, and photographer based in India. His engineering workbench at mrps.in serves as an open laboratory for homelab configurations, C++ firmware, Apple Silicon clustering benchmarks, and edge deployments. Meanwhile, maniratansingh.com captures his human philosophy, creative aesthetics, photography, and tactile interface designs.

His work lives between code, optics, and physical hardware—ranging from high-concurrency healthcare hospital management systems serving regional Purvanchal communities to custom mechanical macropads, home server clusters, and long-exposure light studies.

---

## Complete Project Catalog

### 1. Jellyfin Liquid Glass
- Category: Web & Design / Open Source UI
- Status: Live
- Year: 2025
- GitHub: https://github.com/maniratansingh/jellyfin-liquid-glass
- Description: A ground-up custom UI theme for the Jellyfin web client inspired by Apple's Liquid Glass design language. Replaces rigid layout bars with multi-tiered frosted glass floating controls, object-like posters with subtle edge illumination, and zero external network fonts.
- Architecture:
  - Multi-layered glass weights (dialogs vs floating pills)
  - Zero external HTTP requests for pure privacy and instantaneous rendering
  - Full respect for native OS accessibility (prefers-reduced-motion, high contrast)
  - Pure CSS custom properties and hardware-accelerated backdrop filters

### 2. mrps.in — The Technical Lab
- Category: Web & Design / Edge Infrastructure
- Status: Live
- Year: 2025
- URL: https://mrps.in
- Description: The primary open engineering hub hosting homelab telemetry, C++ hardware write-ups, benchmarking reports, and open-source releases with ultra-fast edge loading.
- Architecture:
  - Sub-second response times with zero client-side tracking or script bloat
  - Static edge deployment with global caching
  - Serves as the raw engineering counterpart to maniratansingh.com

### 3. MRPS Music — Web Vinyl Player
- Category: Web & Design / Creative Audio
- Status: Live
- Year: 2026
- URL: https://mrps.in/projects/aesthetic-music-player/
- GitHub: https://github.com/maniratansingh/aesthetic-music-player
- Description: A sensory web audio experience featuring an interactive vinyl turntable simulation, procedural WebGL background shaders, and realistic needle-drop physics.
- Tech Stack: WebGL 2.0, Web Audio API, Three.js, GLSL Shaders.

### 4. Purvanchal Eye Hospitals Web System
- Category: Community & Health / Public Infrastructure
- Status: Live
- Year: 2026
- URL: https://mrps.in/blog/2026-07-18-building-websites-for-purvanchal-eye-hospitals/
- Description: Designed and deployed fast, accessible websites for real hospitals in Eastern Uttar Pradesh, including Ayodhya Phaco Center, Sunbeam Eye Hospital, and Sant Kabir Eye Hospital.
- Impact: Sub-second load times on rural 3G/4G cellular connections with zero framework bloat, providing critical patient appointment and ophthalmology service directions.

### 5. High-Precision GPS Clock
- Category: Embedded Systems
- Status: Active
- Year: 2026
- URL: https://mrps.in/projects/gpsclock/
- Description: An autonomous, satellite-synchronized hardware timekeeper powered by a u-blox Neo-6M GPS receiver, MAX7219 matrix display, and SSD1306 OLED telemetry interface.
- Tech Stack: Embedded C++, Neo-6M GPS, SPI/I2C buses, non-blocking microcontroller loops.

### 6. Offline Image Compressor for Android
- Category: Open Source / Mobile Systems
- Status: Live
- Year: 2026
- URL: https://mrps.in/projects/image-compressor-mrps/
- Description: A clean, offline Android utility designed to compress high-resolution photos directly on-device without cloud uploads or background trackers. Built natively in Kotlin with Android Jetpack.

### 7. RP2040 OLED Macropad
- Category: Embedded Systems / Tactile Hardware
- Status: Active
- Year: 2024
- GitHub: https://github.com/maniratansingh/rp2040-oled-macropad
- URL: https://mrps.in/projects/rp2040-oled-macropad/
- Description: Bespoke physical input macropad powered by the Raspberry Pi RP2040 microcontroller with hot-swappable mechanical switches, rotary encoder, and monochrome OLED screen. Features sub-millisecond key debouncing and real-time telemetry.
